name: Party o Kunda Onna Kenshi ga Chou Tsuyoindakedo, Seiyoku mo Sore ni Hireishite Tsuyokatta Ken.
original_name: パーティを組んだ女剣士が超強いんだけど、性欲もそれに比例して強かった件。
source:
The young and naive ranger is asked to join a female warrior's party that is considerably stronger than him.

They return from the dungeon, and she forcibly seduces him into a sexual relationship. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE249571.html]DLsite English[/url]]
